(sec-module-symbolics.systemmodel)=
# Module: symbolics.systemModel

The equations of motion of a system of user items as symbolic programs; see the chapter "Symbolic system
and user functions" of the user manual. SymbolicSystem(mbs) collects them, after mbs.Assemble(), from the
user items with symbolic user functions, as UserItemCreator of exudyn.symbolics.userItems creates and
records them: M(q, t) q_tt = f(q, q_t, y, t) - C_q^T z, y_t = g(q, q_t, y, t), c(q, q_t, y, z, t) = 0, with
the data coordinates of the post-Newton steps. It evaluates them - ODE2RHS, MassMatrix, SystemResidual, the
exact SystemJacobian -, gives them as expressions (Equations, also as sympy) or as a flat program
(GetFlatProgram), and writes a state into mbs (SetSystemState). SymbolicSystemBase is the interface on
which the solvers of exudyn.symbolics.solvers work; NumpySystem takes equations written by hand;
SystemVariables gives the variables of the system and the states of the markers as expressions. What
each class and function takes and refuses is in its docstring.

- **Author**: Johannes Gerstmayr
- **Date**: 2026-10-26 (created)

(sec-module-symbolics.systemmodel-class-symbolicsystembase)=
## CLASS SymbolicSystemBase (in module symbolics.systemModel)

**class description**: the equations of a system, the interface on which the solvers work (#3113, #3134), in Exudyn's form: nODE2 second order coordinates q, nODE1 first order coordinates y and nAE algebraic coordinates z - the Lagrange multipliers lambda of the documentation, named z in the code, as lambda is a keyword of Python - with M(q, t) q_tt = f(q, q_t, t, y) - C_q^T z      (ODE2, the reaction forces C_q^T z by ODE2ReactionForcesLHS) y_t = g(q, q_t, y, t)                               (ODE1, ODE1RHS) c(q, q_t, y, z, t) = 0                              (AE, AlgebraicEquations) A derived class sets nODE2 (nODE1 and nAE, zero by default) and computes ODE2RHS and MassMatrixTriplets (or MassMatrix), and ODE1RHS, AlgebraicEquations and ODE2ReactionForcesLHS if it has such coordinates; the residuals and their Jacobians follow from them, unless the derived class computes them itself. Any equation may depend on the coordinates of every kind, so that an item coupling all of them fits

- **notes**: Its members: nODE2, nODE1, nAE, nData, the numbers of coordinates; data, the data coordinates x, which every equation reads and which are constant during the Newton iterations of a step: the solvers set them, after the post-Newton step of PostNewton (#3196)

(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystembase-initialstatedata)=
### Class function: InitialStateData

[`InitialStateData(self)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L105)

- **class function description**: the initial data coordinates x0; empty unless the derived class has data coordinates


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystembase-postnewton)=
### Class function: PostNewton

[`PostNewton(self, q, q_t, y, z, x, x0, t)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L109)

- **class function description**: the post-Newton step after the Newton iterations of a step (#3196): the new data coordinates, the discontinuous error and a recommended step size (< 0: none); the data coordinates x are constant during the Newton iterations, x0 those at the start of the step. The base class has no data coordinates
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates
  - `z`: the algebraic coordinates
  - `x`: the data coordinates of the last iteration
  - `x0`: the data coordinates at the start of the step
  - `t`: the time
- **output**: (x, error, recommendedStepSize)

(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystembase-systemjacobian)=
### Class function: SystemJacobian

[`SystemJacobian(self, q, q_t, q_tt, y, y_t, z, t, factor_q = 1., factor_q_t = 0., factor_q_tt = 0., factor_y = 1., factor_y_t = 0., velocityLevel = False, epsilon = 1e-6)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L202)

- **class function description**: the Jacobian of SystemResidual (#3134), column by column: ODE2 columns factor_q d/dq + factor_q_t d/dq_t + factor_q_tt d/dq_tt, ODE1 columns factor_y d/dy + factor_y_t d/dy_t, AE columns d/dz; the ODE2 block by ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian (exact for a SymbolicSystem), the others by central differences of SystemResidual
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities
  - `q_tt`: the ODE2 accelerations
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates
  - `y_t`: their velocities
  - `z`: the algebraic coordinates, the Lagrange multipliers lambda of the documentation
  - `t`: the time
  - `factor_q`: the factor of d/dq
  - `factor_q_t`: the factor of d/dq_t
  - `factor_q_tt`: the factor of d/dq_tt
  - `factor_y`: the factor of d/dy
  - `factor_y_t`: the factor of d/dy_t
  - `velocityLevel`: the algebraic equations on velocity level
  - `epsilon`: the step of the differences
- **output**: the dense matrix (nSystem x nSystem), nSystem = nODE2 + nODE1 + nAE


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystembase-ode2residuallhsjacobian)=
### Class function: ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian

[`ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian(self, q = None, q_t = None, q_tt = None, t = 0., factor_q = 1., factor_q_t = 0., factor_q_tt = 0., sparse = False, epsilon = 1e-6, y = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L263)

- **class function description**: the Jacobian of the residual, factor_q dr/dq + factor_q_t dr/dq_t + factor_q_tt dr/dq_tt, by central differences of ODE2ResidualLHS - for a system without derivatives of its own; factor_q_tt=1 alone gives the mass matrix, a Newton step of an implicit integrator combines the three
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates, of size nODE2; None: zero
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: zero
  - `q_tt`: the ODE2 accelerations; None: zero
  - `t`: the time
  - `factor_q`: the factor of dr/dq
  - `factor_q_t`: the factor of dr/dq_t
  - `factor_q_tt`: the factor of dr/dq_tt
  - `sparse`: True: a scipy.sparse.csr_matrix, else a dense array
  - `epsilon`: the step of the differences
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates, if the forces depend on them
- **output**: the matrix (nODE2 x nODE2)


(sec-module-symbolics.systemmodel-class-numpysystem(symbolicsystembase))=
## CLASS NumpySystem(SymbolicSystemBase) (in module symbolics.systemModel)

**class description**: equations written by hand, e.g. with numpy: the simplest system for a solver of this module, and a check of it independent of Exudyn (#3112); ODE2 equations M q_tt = f, optionally ODE1 coordinates and constraints (#3134)

- **input**:
  - `massMatrix`: the mass matrix, constant (numpy array or scipy sparse matrix) or a function (q, q_t, t) -> matrix
  - `ode2RHS`: the function (q, q_t, t) -> f of the right-hand side, of size nODE2; with ODE1 coordinates (q, q_t, t, y) -> f
  - `initialState`: (q0, q_t0); None: zero
  - `massMatrixBlocks`: the blocks of bodies as SymbolicSystemBase.MassMatrixBlocks returns them, for a constant mass matrix; None: one block of all coordinates
  - `ode1RHS`: None, or the function (q, q_t, y, t) -> y_t of the ODE1 coordinates
  - `initialStateODE1`: the initial ODE1 coordinates y0, which also give their number
  - `constraints`: None, or the function (q, q_t, y, z, t) -> c of the algebraic equations on position level
  - `constraintJacobian`: the function (q, q_t, y, t) -> C_q (nAE x nODE2) of the reaction forces C_q^T z
  - `numberOfConstraints`: nAE

(sec-module-symbolics.systemmodel-class-symbolickind)=
## CLASS SymbolicKind (in module symbolics.systemModel)

**class description**: the objects of one object type whose user functions are the same recordings: one recording per user function, the table of the objects, their parameters and the global indices of their ODE2 coordinates

- **notes**: Its members: objectType, the type name 'UserBody', 'GenericODE2', 'ConnectorUser', 'JointUser', 'GenericODE1' or 'GenericDAE'; recordings, the dict of the recorded user functions by name (a name without recording is missing); objects, the list of the object numbers; ltg, the array (number of objects x local coordinates) of the global ODE2 indices - of the global ODE1 indices for GenericODE1 -; parameters, the list of the parameter vectors of the objects (UserBody), of the dicts of the constant matrices and the force vector (GenericODE2), or of the dicts of the parameter vector, 'orientation' (the connector gets the rotations and returns the torques) and the markers (ConnectorUser: per marker a dict of its 'type' - 'fixed', 'point' or 'body' -, its local coordinate indices 'indices', its reference 'position' and 'rotation' - for a marker on a user body its local position and rotation, 'objectNumber', 'qRef', 'parameters' and the 'recordings' of the body that give its kinematics), of the dicts of 'parameters', 'markers', 'orientation' and the global indices 'ltgAE' of its algebraic coordinates (JointUser), of the dicts of the system matrix 'A' and the vector 'f' (GenericODE1), or of the dicts of the matrices and vectors by their symbols - 'M', 'D', 'K', 'E', 'A', 'B', 'B_t', 'C_q', 'C_y', 'f', 'g', 'c0', empty if not given -, the 'parameters' and the global indices 'ltgODE1' and 'ltgAE' of its ODE1 and algebraic coordinates (GenericDAE, ltg those of its ODE2 coordinates)

(sec-module-symbolics.systemmodel-class-symbolicload)=
## CLASS SymbolicLoad (in module symbolics.systemModel)

**class description**: a load of the system (#3118): its value, constant or by the recording of its user function of the time, and how it acts on the coordinates - directly on the coordinates of a point node or on one node coordinate, or through a user function of the user body of its marker

- **notes**: Its members: loadNumber; loadType, 'ForceVector', 'TorqueVector', 'MassProportional' or 'Coordinate'; ltg, the global ODE2 indices it acts on; value, the loadVector or load; recording, the recorded loadVectorUserFunction or loadUserFunction, None if constant; body, None for a node marker, else the dict of the user body: 'objectNumber', 'localPosition', 'qRef', 'parameters', 'projection' (the recording of the function whose transposed maps the load into the coordinates) with its 'projectionName', and 'rotation' (the recorded rotationMatrixUserFunction for bodyFixed, else None); ode1, True for a LoadCoordinate on an ODE1 coordinate, whose ltg are global ODE1 indices and which adds to the right-hand side of the ODE1 equations (#3144)

(sec-module-symbolics.systemmodel-class-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase))=
## CLASS SymbolicSystem(SymbolicSystemBase) (in module symbolics.systemModel)

**class description**: the ODE2 equations of motion of mbs, by kinds of objects with symbolic user functions, evaluated by exudyn.symbolic (#3110, #3113); mbs must be assembled; see the Details of this module for the items it takes

- **input**:
  - `mbs`: the assembled MainSystem
  - `composeSystem`: True: ODE2RHS, MassMatrix and ODE2ResidualLHS evaluate two recordings of the composed system - the forces and the nonzero entries of the mass matrix of Equations(), each one flat program (#3131) -; False: each object and load by its own recordings, one call each
  - `parameters`: None, or the ParameterBindings of the parameters of user items - ObjectUserBody, ObjectConnectorUser, ObjectJointUser -, each a number or an expression of named variables of mbs.symbolicVariables, the values those of the item: UserItemCreator.parameterBindings; Equations() keeps the expressions, the parameters are the named variables in them (#3152, #3159, #3208); the recordings of the composed system and of the items take their values as the input p, so that SetParameterValues records nothing again, and ODE2RHSParameterJacobian and MassMatrixParameterJacobian are the derivatives by them
- **notes**: Its members: mbs; kinds, the list of SymbolicKind; jointKinds, the list of SymbolicKind of the ObjectJointUser (#3141), whose constraint equations are AlgebraicEquations and whose reaction forces are ODE2ReactionForcesLHS - in Equations() on request (#3146) -; ode1Kinds, the list of SymbolicKind of the ObjectGenericODE1 (#3144), whose right-hand side is ODE1RHS; daeKinds, the list of SymbolicKind of the ObjectGenericDAE (#3190), which add to the ODE2, the ODE1 and the algebraic equations; loads, the list of SymbolicLoad on ODE2 coordinates, ode1Loads those on ODE1 coordinates; nODE2, nODE1, the numbers of ODE2 and ODE1 coordinates of the system; nAE, the number of the algebraic equations; qRef, the reference values of the ODE2 coordinates; composed, None or the dict of the recordings 'ODE2RHS', 'massMatrix' and 'massMatrixBlocks' - esym.Function of the inputs q, q_t and t, the VariableSet 'inputs' (#3149), with the parameters p after them - and the 'rows' and 'columns' of the entries of the mass matrix; parameterBindings, the ParameterBindings, checked; parameterNames, the names of the parameters in the order of p

(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-ode1rhs)=
### Class function: ODE1RHS

[`ODE1RHS(self, q, q_t, y, t)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L991)

- **class function description**: the right-hand side g(q, q_t, y, t) of the ODE1 equations y_t = g (#3144): per ObjectGenericODE1 A y + f and its recorded rhsUserFunction of its coordinates, as CObjectGenericODE1 computes it, per ObjectGenericDAE A y + B q + B_t q_t + g + g_u (#3190), and the LoadCoordinate on ODE1 coordinates
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates, used by ObjectGenericDAE only
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities, used by ObjectGenericDAE only
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates, of size nODE1
  - `t`: the time
- **output**: the vector g of size nODE1


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-ode1reactiontermslhs)=
### Class function: ODE1ReactionTermsLHS

[`ODE1ReactionTermsLHS(self, q, q_t, y, z, t)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1113)

- **class function description**: the reaction terms C_y^T z of the algebraic coordinates of the ObjectGenericDAE in the ODE1 equations, on their left-hand side (#3155, #3190), of size nODE1


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-ode1jacobian)=
### Class function: ODE1Jacobian

[`ODE1Jacobian(self, y, t, q = None, q_t = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1140)

- **class function description**: the derivative of ODE1RHS by y (nODE1 x nODE1), exact: A and the derivative of the recorded rhsUserFunction (#3144, #3116); q and q_t, zero if None, for an ObjectGenericDAE (#3190)


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-setsystemstate)=
### Class function: SetSystemState

[`SetSystemState(self, q, q_t = None, q_tt = None, t = None, configuration = exudyn.ConfigurationType.Current)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1168)

- **class function description**: write a state into mbs: the ODE2 coordinates, velocities and accelerations and the time - None leaves one unchanged -, so that the sensors, the output functions (Current) and the renderer (Visualization) show it
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates, of size nODE2
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: unchanged
  - `q_tt`: the ODE2 accelerations; None: unchanged
  - `t`: the time; None: unchanged
  - `configuration`: the configuration written, exudyn.ConfigurationType.Current or Visualization


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-algebraicequations)=
### Class function: AlgebraicEquations

[`AlgebraicEquations(self, q, q_t, y, z, t, velocityLevel = False)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1236)

- **class function description**: the constraint equations c(q, y, t) at position level: of the joints by their recorded constraintUserFunction (#3141), of the ObjectGenericDAE C_q q + C_y y - c_0 (#3190); the velocity level is not given
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities, not used
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates, used by ObjectGenericDAE only
  - `z`: the algebraic coordinates, the Lagrange multipliers lambda of the documentation, not used
  - `t`: the time
  - `velocityLevel`: must be False
- **output**: the vector c of size nAE


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-ode2reactionforceslhs)=
### Class function: ODE2ReactionForcesLHS

[`ODE2ReactionForcesLHS(self, q, q_t, y, z, t)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1272)

- **class function description**: the reaction forces C_q^T z of the joints (#3141): the recorded jacobianUserFunction C by the marker translations and global rotation increments, C^T z the forces and torques on the markers, projected into the coordinates by the position and rotation Jacobians of the markers, as the forces of a connector; of the ObjectGenericDAE C_q^T z by its matrix (#3190)
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities, not used
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates, not used
  - `z`: the algebraic coordinates, the Lagrange multipliers lambda of the documentation
  - `t`: the time
- **output**: the vector of size nODE2


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-systemjacobian)=
### Class function: SystemJacobian

[`SystemJacobian(self, q, q_t, q_tt, y, y_t, z, t, factor_q = 1., factor_q_t = 0., factor_q_tt = 0., factor_y = 1., factor_y_t = 0., velocityLevel = False, epsilon = 1e-6)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1313)

- **class function description**: the Jacobian of SystemResidual, exact (#3145): the ODE2 block by ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian plus the derivative of the reaction forces, the blocks C_q^T and C_q of the joints by _JointJacobian, the ODE1 block by ODE1Jacobian; the arguments as SymbolicSystemBase.SystemJacobian, epsilon not used
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities
  - `q_tt`: the ODE2 accelerations
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates
  - `y_t`: their velocities
  - `z`: the algebraic coordinates, the Lagrange multipliers lambda of the documentation
  - `t`: the time
  - `factor_q`: the factor of d/dq
  - `factor_q_t`: the factor of d/dq_t
  - `factor_q_tt`: the factor of d/dq_tt
  - `factor_y`: the factor of d/dy
  - `factor_y_t`: the factor of d/dy_t
  - `velocityLevel`: must be False, as for AlgebraicEquations
  - `epsilon`: not used
- **output**: the dense matrix (nSystem x nSystem), nSystem = nODE2 + nODE1 + nAE


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-ode2rhs)=
### Class function: ODE2RHS

[`ODE2RHS(self, q = None, q_t = None, t = 0., y = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1520)

- **class function description**: the global forces f(q, q_t, t, y) of the right-hand side, as the ODE2 part of the solver's right-hand side
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates (displacements), of size nODE2; None: zero
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: zero
  - `t`: the time
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates, of size nODE1, used by an ObjectGenericDAE with ODE2 and ODE1 coordinates only - which needs them (#3190) -; None: zero
- **output**: the vector f of size nODE2


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-massmatrixtriplets)=
### Class function: MassMatrixTriplets

[`MassMatrixTriplets(self, q = None, q_t = None, t = 0.)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1565)

- **class function description**: the global mass matrix as triplets (rows, columns, values), a value per nonzero local entry; equal rows and columns are added when the matrix is formed


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-massmatrixblocks)=
### Class function: MassMatrixBlocks

[`MassMatrixBlocks(self, q = None, q_t = None, t = 0.)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1584)

- **class function description**: the local mass matrices of the objects, per kind: a list of (ltg, blocks), the LTG table of the kind and its mass matrices (objects x n x n)


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-ode2residuallhs)=
### Class function: ODE2ResidualLHS

[`ODE2ResidualLHS(self, q = None, q_t = None, q_tt = None, t = 0., y = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1600)

- **class function description**: the residual r = M(q) q_tt - f(q, q_t, t, y) of the ODE2 equations, LHS minus RHS, without forming M: by the recordings of the composed system, else object by object; y as in ODE2RHS


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-ode2residuallhsjacobian)=
### Class function: ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian

[`ODE2ResidualLHSJacobian(self, q = None, q_t = None, q_tt = None, t = 0., factor_q = 1., factor_q_t = 0., factor_q_tt = 0., sparse = False, y = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1622)

- **class function description**: the Jacobian of the residual, factor_q dr/dq + factor_q_t dr/dq_t + factor_q_tt dr/dq_tt, exact by the derivatives of the recordings (UserFunction.EvaluateJacobian, #3115, in one pass over the flat program #3116): of the composed system up to _denseMassMatrixSize coordinates - two calls, a dense Jacobian -, else object by object, sparse; factor_q_tt=1 alone gives the mass matrix, a Newton step of an implicit integrator combines the three
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates, of size nODE2; None: zero
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: zero
  - `q_tt`: the ODE2 accelerations; None: zero
  - `t`: the time
  - `factor_q`: the factor of dr/dq
  - `factor_q_t`: the factor of dr/dq_t
  - `factor_q_tt`: the factor of dr/dq_tt
  - `sparse`: True: a scipy.sparse.csr_matrix, else a dense array
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates, as in ODE2RHS
- **output**: the matrix (nODE2 x nODE2)


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-ode2rhsparameterjacobian)=
### Class function: ODE2RHSParameterJacobian

[`ODE2RHSParameterJacobian(self, q = None, q_t = None, t = 0., y = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1724)

- **class function description**: the derivative df/dp of the forces of ODE2RHS by the parameters, in the order of parameterNames: one call of the one-pass derivative of the composed system by its input p, as dr/dq by q (#3159)
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates, of size nODE2; None: zero
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: zero
  - `t`: the time
  - `y`: the ODE1 coordinates, as in ODE2RHS
- **output**: the matrix (nODE2 x number of parameters)


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-massmatrixparameterjacobian)=
### Class function: MassMatrixParameterJacobian

[`MassMatrixParameterJacobian(self, q = None, q_t = None, t = 0.)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1742)

- **class function description**: the derivatives dM/dp_k of the mass matrix by the parameters, in the order of parameterNames, by one call of the one-pass derivative of the composed system by its input p (#3159)
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates, of size nODE2; None: zero
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: zero
  - `t`: the time
- **output**: the array (number of parameters x nODE2 x nODE2), dM/dp_k at index k


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-equations)=
### Class function: Equations

[`Equations(self, format = 'symbolic', optimize = True, variables = None, massMatrix = True, ODE2RHS = True, massMatrixBlocks = False, algebraicEquations = False, ODE2ReactionForcesLHS = False, ODE1RHS = False, ODE1ReactionTermsLHS = False, postNewton = False)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L1862)

- **class function description**: the equations of motion M(q, t) q_tt = f(q, q_t, t) of the system as expressions in its variables (#3130, #3132), composed of the recordings of the kinds, the marker kinematics of the connectors and the loads; each recording is called with symbolic arguments through its code of exudyn.symbolics.codeExport, the parameters of the items and the reference coordinates are numbers. The forces f are the whole right-hand side - the forces of the bodies (their quadratic velocity terms), of the connectors and of the loads -, the same whether the accelerations are solved with the global mass matrix or with the inverse of the mass matrix of each body (explicit.computeMassMatrixInversePerBody), for which massMatrixBlocks gives the matrices of the bodies
- **input**:
  - `format`: 'symbolic': exudyn.symbolic expressions, the variables named vectors q, q_t (with the initial state as values) and the real t; 'sympy': sympy expressions of the symbols q0, q1, ..., q_t0, ..., t (sympy must be installed)
  - `optimize`: for 'symbolic', simplify the expressions by exudyn.symbolic.Optimize, level 2 (1*x, x+0, 0*x, the combination of numbers, ...)
  - `variables`: None, or (q, q_t, t) of the format given by the caller - e.g. the arguments of a function being recorded -, used instead of new variables; (q, q_t, t, z) with the algebraic coordinates, (q, q_t, t, z, y) with the ODE1 coordinates
  - `massMatrix`: True: the global mass matrix, 'massMatrix' (nODE2 x nODE2)
  - `ODE2RHS`: True: the forces of the right-hand side, 'ODE2RHS' (nODE2)
  - `massMatrixBlocks`: True: the mass matrices of the bodies, 'massMatrixBlocks', as MassMatrixBlocks() gives
  - `them`: a list per kind of bodies of (ltg, matrices), the LTG table of the kind (bodies x n) and the list of their n x n matrices
  - `algebraicEquations`: True: the constraint equations c(q, t) of the joints, 'algebraicEquations' (nAE), as AlgebraicEquations (#3146)
  - `ODE2ReactionForcesLHS`: True: the reaction forces C_q^T z of the joints, 'ODE2ReactionForcesLHS' (nODE2), as ODE2ReactionForcesLHS, of the algebraic coordinates, the variable 'z' (#3146)
  - `ODE1RHS`: True: the right-hand side g(q, q_t, y, t) of the ODE1 equations y_t = g, 'ODE1RHS' (nODE1), as ODE1RHS, of the ODE1 coordinates, the variable 'y' with the initial ODE1 state (#3162)
  - `ODE1ReactionTermsLHS`: True: the reaction terms C_y^T z of the ObjectGenericDAE in the ODE1 equations, 'ODE1ReactionTermsLHS' (nODE1), as ODE1ReactionTermsLHS, of the variable 'z' (#3190)
  - `postNewton`: True: 'postNewton', the results [error, recommendedStepSize, data] of the recorded post-Newton functions, item after item as PostNewton takes them, of the variables and 'x0', the data coordinates at the start of the step (#3196)
- **output**: dict with 'q', 'q_t', 't' (the variables), 'z' if ODE2ReactionForcesLHS, ODE1ReactionTermsLHS or a constraintUserFunction in algebraicEquations (#3191), 'y' if ODE1RHS or the system has an ObjectGenericDAE with ODE1 coordinates (#3190), 'x' - the data coordinates, which the equations read as constant in a step - if the system has data coordinates, 'x0' if postNewton (#3196), 'parameters' - the named parameters of parameterBindings, as exudyn.symbolic.Real or sympy symbols - if there are any (#3152, #3159), and the results asked for, exudyn.symbolic.Matrix and Vector or sympy.Matrix


(sec-systemmodel-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-getflatprogram)=
### Class function: GetFlatProgram

[`GetFlatProgram(self, format = 'Python', flatten = True, results = ['ODE2RHS', 'massMatrix'])`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/systemModel.py#L2326)

- **class function description**: the flat program of results of Equations(), a function of q, q_t and t - and z with 'ODE2ReactionForcesLHS' or 'ODE1ReactionTermsLHS', y with 'ODE1RHS' or an ObjectGenericDAE with ODE1 coordinates (#3130, #3132, #3146, #3190)
- **input**:
  - `format`: 'Python' (the text), or the executable 'symbolic', 'numpy' or 'sympy' of exudyn.symbolics.codeExport
  - `flatten`: True: one line per operation; False: each result as one expression
  - `results`: the names of the results: 'ODE2RHS', 'massMatrix', 'algebraicEquations', 'ODE2ReactionForcesLHS', 'ODE1RHS', 'ODE1ReactionTermsLHS', 'postNewton'
- **output**: the program as str, for the executable formats a function Equations(q, q_t, t) - Equations(q, q_t, t, z) with z, then y, x and x0 if the equations have them (#3196), followed by the named parameters (#3152) - returning the results

(sec-module-symbolics.systemmodel-class-systemvariables)=
## CLASS SystemVariables (in module symbolics.systemModel)

**class description**: the system variables of a SymbolicSystem in one exudyn.symbolic.VariableSet (#3151): the named vectors q and q_t (the ODE2 coordinates and velocities, relative to the reference coordinates, as in systemData), y and y_t (the ODE1 coordinates and their derivatives), z (the algebraic coordinates, the Lagrange multipliers lambda of the documentation) and the real t, with the initial state as values; the states of markers as expressions of them - of the coordinates of the node for a marker on a point node, by the recordings of the user body for a marker on it, constants for the ground -, by the same composition as Equations(); an expression of marker states is a function of the system coordinates, whose Jacobian EvaluateJacobian of Function gives in one pass

- **input**:
  - `system`: the SymbolicSystem
- **notes**: Its members: system; variables, the VariableSet of q, q_t, y, y_t, z and t in this order; q, q_t, y, y_t, z, t, its variables. Example: variables = SystemVariables(system) distance = variables.MarkerPosition(m1) - variables.MarkerPosition(m0) F = variables.Function(distance) F.EvaluateJacobian('q', q, q_t, y, y_t, z, t) #the Jacobian of the distance by the ODE2 coordinates
